candidates.title: The Pots That Cracked Before the Fair
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the pottery stall's newest bowls cracked during their first firing during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they lowered the furnace temperature but the next bowls still split; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized the thick clay bases had retained moisture that expanded as steam; they planned a safer joint response.
With the community helpers watching, they dried a test batch thoroughly before firing and remade the damaged bowls, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Delivery Robot That Kept Coming Back
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered a small delivery robot returned to the same doorstep with every parcel during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they cleaned its wheels but it completed the same mistaken route; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized two destinations had been assigned one identical route identifier; they planned a safer joint response.

With the community helpers watching, they gave each destination a distinct identifier and checked the full delivery route, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Tickets Nobody Could Read
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the school fair's winning ticket numbers vanished under the festival lights during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they printed darker tickets but the letters still seemed to disappear; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized a colored filter over the stage lamps made the ticket ink blend into the paper; they planned a safer joint response.

With the community helpers watching, they read the originals under neutral lamps and printed high-contrast replacements, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
